# Subject API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

An animal in a study, described by its species, strain, sex and the procedures and logs recorded for it.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/subject/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/subject/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `subject` (detail, create, update), `subjects` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `name` unique across BrainSTEM
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/), [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/), [`subjectlog`](/api/modules/subjectlog/) records; refused (400) while [`breeding`](/api/stem/breeding/), [`procedureepisode`](/api/modules/procedureepisode/) records point to it; clears the link on [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids **[required]**; nestable |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids; nestable. Licenses covering this subject for regulatory reporting and compliance |
| `species` | [`species`](/api/taxonomies/species/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `strain` | [`strain`](/api/taxonomies/strain/) id; nullable; nestable. The strain of the subject, when one is defined. |
| `sex` | one of `F`, `M`, `U` **[required]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `active`, `inactive`, `transferred`, `deceased`, `unknown` **[required]**. Current participation status of the subject in research activities |
| `genetic_line` | string; max 100 characters. The genetic line of your subject, e.g., Wild type or local genetic line: PV-Cre x Ai32 line A |
| `genotype` | string; max 200 characters. Confirmed genotype, e.g., 'PV-Cre/wt; Ai32/wt'. BrainSTEM also has Genotyping as a Subject log type, to describe the genotyping procedure and detailed results. |
| `subject_identifier` | string; max 100 characters |
| `supplier` | [`supplier`](/api/resources/supplier/) id; nullable |
| `breeding` | [`breeding`](/api/stem/breeding/) id; nullable; nestable |
| `birth_date` | date; nullable |
| `death_date` | date; nullable |
| `extra_fields` | JSON object |
| `procedures` | list of [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `subjectlogs` | list of [`subjectlog`](/api/modules/subjectlog/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `tags` | list of strings; filter with `filter{tags.name}=<name>` |
| `name_used_in_storage` | string; max 200 characters; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/subject/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('subject', load_all=True)
records = resp['subjects']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('subject', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.subjects;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/subject/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('subject', data={"name": "Subject 1", "projects": ["<project-id>"], "species": "<species-id>", "sex": "F", "status": "active"})
record = resp.json()['subject']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Subject 1', 'projects', {{'<project-id>'}}, 'species', '<species-id>', 'sex', 'F', 'status', 'active'), 'subject');
record = created.subject;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/subject/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('subject', id='<id>', data={"name": "Subject 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Subject 1 (renamed)'), 'subject', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/subject/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('subject', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'subject');
```

## JSON field schemas

Schemas for the additional fields of a subject. The REST API returns these JSON fields as stored and validates writes against the schemas below. Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Subject/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).

### Additional fields

- type code `Array` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Subject/Array/1.0.1.json)

Any extra parameters you want to add to this subject. Saved as key-value pairs. Values can be strings or numbers.

| Property | Description |
|:---------|:------------|
| `key` | text |
| `value` | object |

Illustrative payload:

```json
[
    {
        "key": "text",
        "value": {}
    }
]
```


## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Subject data model page](/datamodel/stem/subject/).

## Usage notes

- `extra_fields` is a JSON object whose keys start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores; values are strings or numbers.
